headline: Wham!中國巡演紀錄片上映
context: 英國樂團 Wham! 主唱喬治·麥可（George Michael）與安德魯·瑞吉里（Andrew Ridgeley），在1985年成為第一支登陸中國演出的西方流行樂團。新紀錄片重新剪接了導演林賽·安德森（Lindsay Anderson）當年因這趟拍攝而遭解雇的素材，回顧這趟演出背後流行文化與政治體制碰撞的過程。倫敦達利奇美術館（Dulwich Picture Gallery）同時推出攝影展《Portrait of a City》，展出史蒂格利茲（Alfred Stieglitz）、蘭格（Dorothea Lange）等攝影師記錄的美國城市百年樣貌。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The duo’s groundbreaking 1985 tour reveals a strange collision of pop stardom and communism, a re-edit of Lindsay Anderson’s efforts that got him fired Here is a documentary that has a very important story to tell, maybe more important than it feels comfortable admitting. It’s about two separate subjects – or maybe three: Wham!, China and film-maker Lindsay Anderson. A superpower nervously edging towards western-style openness, a pop band nervously doing what needed to be done to make it big in the US, and a great film director, needing the money, taking on a project he didn’t really believe in. In 1985, Wham!’s beetle-browed manager Simon Napier-Bell had a cunning plan for how George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley could break the US: Wham! would be the first ever western pop band to perform in mainland China. They would play where the Beatles, the Stones and Elvis had never played, and the resulting global publicity would launch them into the US. (He was right – it did.) In our modern age, the movie and music businesses routinely consider China as the key element of the all-important Asian market, but in 1985, Michael and Ridgeley were the Kirk and Spock of the charts, going where no pop act had gone before. sources.summary: The British pop duo Wham! was the first Western act of its kind to play mainland China. This documentary reveals the hidden agenda of the shows.

sources.summary: Dulwich Picture Gallery, London Era-defining photographs from the likes of Alfred Stieglitz, Saul Leiter and Dorothea Lange showcase the urban landscape, from midnight crime scenes to gloomy corridors This – only the second photography exhibition in Dulwich Picture Gallery’s history – is a quietly contemplative but gripping show that traces two intersecting developments: the construction of the modern urban environment and the language of photography. Focusing exclusively on works from era-defining photographers of the 20th century made in cities across the US, it’s a concise overview that begins with the pictorialist pioneers of New York, Alfred Stieglitz and Edward Steichen, and keeps moving through masterpieces, starting with early examples of social documentary photography – Dorothea Lange’s Migrant Mother and White Angel Breadline, and Lewis Hine’s emblematic portrait of the high-steel ironworker Victor “Frenchy” Gosselin working on the construction of the Empire State Building. Wham!中國巡演紀錄片上映

英國樂團 Wham! 的喬治·麥可（George Michael）與安德魯·瑞吉里（Andrew Ridgeley），1985年成了第一支到中國演出的西方流行樂團。新紀錄片重新剪輯了導演林賽·安德森（Lindsay Anderson）當年因這趟拍攝而遭解雇的素材，回顧那次演出裡流行文化與政治體制的碰撞。

同一天，倫敦達利奇美術館（Dulwich Picture Gallery）也推出攝影展《Portrait of a City》，展出史蒂格利茲（Alfred Stieglitz）、蘭格（Dorothea Lange）等攝影師拍下的美國城市百年樣貌。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times，2026 年 7 月 28 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
Wham!中國巡演紀錄片上映

英國樂團 Wham! 的喬治·麥可（George Michael）與安德魯·瑞吉里（Andrew Ridgeley），在1985年成了第一支登陸中國演出的西方流行樂團——這是他們經紀人為了打進美國市場想出的奇招，結果真的奏效了。新紀錄片重新剪輯了導演林賽·安德森（Lindsay Anderson）當年因這趟拍攝而遭解雇的素材，回顧演出背後流行文化與政治體制的碰撞。

視覺藝術這邊還有一則。倫敦達利奇美術館（Dulwich Picture Gallery）推出攝影展《Portrait of a City》，這是該館史上第二檔攝影展，展出史蒂格利茲（Alfred Stieglitz）、蘭格（Dorothea Lange）等攝影師記錄的美國城市百年樣貌，從紐約的街景一路拍到帝國大廈的工地現場。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 7 月 28 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 1985年，英國樂團 Wham! 成了第一支登陸中國演出的西方流行樂團。這趟演出背後其實有段隱藏的故事——新紀錄片重新剪輯了一批當年因為這趟拍攝而遭解雇的導演留下的素材，回顧流行文化與政治體制碰撞的過程。視覺藝術這邊也有新消息。倫敦一間美術館推出攝影展，展出多位攝影師記錄的美國城市百年樣貌，從早期的街景一路拍到摩天大樓的工地現場。
